This '''clone trooper commander''' was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[187th Legion/Legends|187th Legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

==Biography==
===Siege of Dantooine===
A clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the 187th Legion's commander was trained from birth<ref name="clone troopers" /> to become the commander of a clone unit and to utilize [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone airborne armor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> They were assigned to the 187th Legion as their clone commander, and was specifically trained to be able to support their Jedi General in combat.<ref name="Unleashed">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Unleashed|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=187th Legion Troopers (Ultimate Battles)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw07unlUB-187.asp}}</ref>

At the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], immediately after the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began using the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] as a staging ground against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Learning of this Separatist presence, [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] Mace Windu dispatched an army of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to take back the planet. During the battle, the clone commander commanded the 187th Legion, and secured an important victory for the clone army, which allowed the Republic to take control of the planet.<ref name="Unleashed" />

===Assault on the Jedi Temple===
During the final stages of the war, the Confederacy of Independent Systems launched a full scale [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|invasion]] on the Republic's [[Coruscant/Legends|capital]]. During this battle, the [[Droid Army|droid army]] began an assault on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The 187th Legion, alongside their Jedi General, fought to protect the temple. During the raid, the clone commander utilized a series of hand signals to efficiently control and direct their [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of clone troopers.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, the 187th Legion's clone commander was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. They had short black hair, tan skin, and brown eyes.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Being a member of the 187th Legion, the commander was considered to be a superior warrior, and was specifically trained to be able to assist High Jedi General Mace Windu in combat.<ref name="Unleashed" /> During the Battle of Coruscant, the clone commander showed exceptional leading skills, as they were able to command their entire unit with a simple series of hand signals.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Equipment==
[[File:187thLeader.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The clone commander's airborne armor.]]
The 187th's clone commander wore standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II clone paratrooper armor]], equipped with a beige [[Kama/Legends|kama]]. Their armor was adorned with light blue and purple markings, and wore a bandoleer over their chest plate which they used to carry a modified [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]] that fired red [[Blaster/Legends|blaster bolts]]. During battle, they also utilized a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
This clone commander was created for the [[2006]] Target exclusive "Mace Windu's Attack battalion" battle pack, where they appeared alongside Mace Windu and three other members of the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> In [[2007]], ''[[Star Wars Unleashed]]'' released a miniature pack of the 187th Legion, that featured the commander and three of their troopers.<ref name="Unleashed" /> Finally, in [[2010]], [[Gentle Giant Studios]] released a mini-bust of the commander.
